1933, June
FR. SOLANUS, NOTEBOOK NO. 5.
Page 119 Cont.
June Elanore Salesbury - 45 - Gall-stone trouble C. G. - about 50 - heart trouble Family in trouble -
Genevieve Butler - 36 - of 2586 Dickerson Ave. - very lame - like paralized since two yrs. old - goes to communion every day. pointed to as .... "why does God leave her so .....?
A Contract -
Mable A. Brown - 59 - cancer of the face, intending to go to Rochester, Minn. to - morrow.
Blank page
Page 120 Page 121 June 28 Rose Mary Cowan - 44 - nerveous etc, etc. - necessar ....
Mr. Horetske - 55 of Pt. Huron - "growing sickness, rupture, rhumatism.
Mrs. Guzowiski - 83 - Rhumatism.
Helena Hyland - 46 - Harper Hosp. fears operation - lung-colaps.
Coneff Garland - c. Philis Holmes - 18 - fears operation
Mrs. Philip M - 47 - Thanks for prayers 6 mo. ago. - back-ache gone - none feet ....
Richard H. - 19 - mo. ... . mastoids. Mrs. Ed Zabloski - 19 lump in breast - Fosaline T. - 19 - blind ..
July July 5th
1933, July
John Obezed - 58 - Syrian-Orthodox - blind - almost - 14 months - no religion prac ....
